items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: He used to play violin when I was going to school.

ctx.x: He looks like he's doing pretty well.
Yeah. He used to play violin when I was going to school. He used to play the march for us to march up in the room on violin.

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
